page: Amazon Web Services i7i.8xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) utilizing the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8559C processor running at 3.2 GHz. The CPU architecture includes a 320 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, yielding a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Local storage consists of a bundled 7500 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is provisioned with a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark data indicates strong memory subsystem performance, with large-block read and write memory bandwidth scoring in the top 25%. Computational performance is highlighted by a top-tier (top 10%) Geekbench single-core score and a strong (top 25%) Geekbench multi-core score. Single-threaded gzip compression and both single- and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression also rank in the top 25%. In database-related metrics, the instance achieves average performance in Passmark database operations and Redis SET operations. For machine learning tasks, the hardware demonstrates strong prompt processing across various model sizes, achieving top-tier text generation speeds for small 135M models, though text generation for large 70B models drops to the bottom 25%.

The qualitative cost efficiency of the i7i.8xlarge is defined by its high local NVMe storage density and DDR5 memory capacity relative to its 32 vCPUs. This resource balance makes it suitable for storage-intensive and memory-intensive workloads. Appropriate deployment scenarios include large-scale databases, data warehousing, and transactional systems requiring high local IOPS. It is also applicable for text processing, image processing, and moderate language model inference, though it is not optimized for large-scale LLM text generation due to the lack of dedicated GPU acceleration and lower text generation throughput on massive models.
description: Amazon Web Services i7i.8xlarge is a storage-optimized instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor at 3.2 GHz. It includes 256.0 GB of DDR5 memory and a bundled 7500 GB NVMe SSD, operating on the Nitro hypervisor with a 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark results show strong performance in large-block memory bandwidth, single-core Geekbench execution, and data decompression. While it achieves top-tier text generation speeds for small language models, text generation for large 70B models is a performance tradeoff, ranking in the bottom 25%. This instance is structured for storage-heavy and memory-intensive applications, making it suitable for relational databases, transactional workloads, and data processing tasks that benefit from high-capacity local NVMe storage and fast memory access.
